free_tier_limits: No current public cloud free tier. Only previously licensed Space On-Premises instances that activated a perpetual license by May 31, 2025 may continue indefinitely for free.
description: JetBrains Space Cloud and its hosted HTTP API were discontinued; cloud organizations were disabled June 1, 2025. The API remains usable only on previously licensed Space On-Premises installations that activated a perpetual license before the deadline. Requests use the installation's own host and can automate modules including projects, repositories, issues, packages, chats, and team-directory data.
